description: Find parcels at a lat/lon point — returns the parcel(s) whose boundary contains or sits near the coordinate, with owner, zoning, land use, acreage, and boundary. Example: regrid_parcel_by_point({ lat: 38.8977, lon: -77.0365, _apiKey: "your-token" })

_apiKey.description: Regrid API token (get one free at regrid.com — 30-day sandbox)

radius.description: Optional search radius in meters around the point

name: regrid_parcel_by_point
